subject: Supplier setup: kickoff call + roles, timeline & success metrics
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@brightbridge.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightbridge.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup kickoff request — BrightBridge / Redwood

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the intro. We're ready to kick off vendor setup for BrightBridge's pilot with Redwood. To get the PO and onboarding completed on our side we typically need:
- Completed procurement onboarding form (attached)
- Vendor W-9 or equivalent tax docs
- Standard PO terms confirmation (currency, billing cadence)
- Point of contact for SSO/KMS evidence if required

Would you be available for a 30-minute kickoff this week? I can do: Tue 5/4 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 5/5 14:00-15:00 PT.

I attached our onboarding form (BBI_Procurement_Onboarding_Form.pdf). Happy to walk through it on the call.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lin
Senior Procurement Manager, BrightBridge Inc.
procurement@brightbridge.com

Attachment: BBI_Procurement_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@brightbridge.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup kickoff request — BrightBridge / Redwood

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the form. Tue 5/4 10:00 PT works for us. I'll send a calendar invite.

Proposed 30-min agenda so we can keep it focused:
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Procurement checklist review (onboarding form, tax docs) (10m)
3) PO & billing cadence / invoicing contact (5m)
4) Tech handoffs (SSO/KMS/placement of logs) & timing (5m)
5) Next steps & ownership (5m)

Mutual action plan (MAP): I created a short MAP doc so we can assign owners — link below. During the call we can agree on milestones and target dates (PO issued, SSO/provisioning, test calls).

I attached our vendor intake checklist (redwood_vendor_checklist.xlsx) to show what Finance and Security will need from your side.

Attendees from Redwood: me (Vendor onboarding lead), Rishi (Finance lead), Laura (Security & compliance).

See you Tue.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Procurement & Vendor Ops, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_vendor_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-Redwood-BBI-Onboard (MAP + checklist)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Sara Lin <sara.lin@brightbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup kickoff request — BrightBridge / Redwood

Quick note from Finance:
- For deals under $50k we can accept Net-30 via standard PO. Above that we'll need an approved contract and a PO with an assigned SOW/line item.
- Please confirm billing entity (BrightBridge Inc. vs regional subsidiary) and preferred invoicing email.

I attached a short summary of PO terms we typically surface (PO_Terms_Summary.md). We'll cover the thresholds on the call and mark action owner for the invoice recipient.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO_Terms_Summary.md (text/markdown)

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@brightbridge.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@brightbridge.com, andrew.holt@brightbridge.com
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup kickoff request — BrightBridge / Redwood

Perfect — thanks Soojin and Rishi. Confirming Tue 5/4 10:00 PT.

A few pre-call notes:
- Billing entity: BrightBridge Inc. (domestic). Invoices go to ap-invoices@brightbridge.com (we'll share contact during call).
- I'll bring Andrew Holt (ops lead) to cover tax docs and DocuSign flow.
- I'll upload signed W-9 and vendor paperwork to the Drive folder after the call — W-9 is attached for your review.

See you Tuesday.

Best,
Sara

Attachment: BrightBridge_W9.pdf (application/pdf)
Link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/12345-BBI-Vendor-Agreement

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@brightbridge.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup kickoff request — BrightBridge / Redwood

Thanks all — calendar invite sent (30m). Finalizing the kickoff MAP and success criteria here so we start the call with clear ownership:

Success criteria (what "done" looks like within 14 days):
- PO issued and received by Redwood AP (Owner: BrightBridge AP contact) — target: Day 5
- Tax & vendor docs uploaded to shared Drive (Owner: BrightBridge procurement) — target: Day 3
- SSO provisioning ticket submitted to Redwood SRE & test call completed (Owner: Redwood Security / Laura) — target: Day 10
- Initial test inference call (sanity run) completed and logged (Owner: Redwood Onboarding / Soojin) — target: Day 12

Key stakeholders & owners (will update MAP during call):
- BrightBridge: Sara Lin (procurement), Andrew Holt (ops), AP (invoicing)
- Redwood: Soojin Lee (vendor onboarding), Rishi Malhotra (finance/compliance flags), Laura Bennett (security)

Pre-call asks for BrightBridge (please upload before Tue 10:00 PT):
- Completed onboarding form (BBI_Procurement_Onboarding_Form.pdf)
- W-9 + any regional tax docs (BrightBridge_W9.pdf)
- Preferred billing email and PO contact

If anything changes on timing, let me know. Otherwise we'll use the call to assign MAP owners and capture line-item dates in the Drive link.

Cheers,
Soojin
Procurement & Vendor Ops, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-Redwood-BBI-Onboard (MAP + checklist)
